notes:
Chunk 14 has six pages, each with a single Common Crawl capture (no live copies); sourceUrl is the index.commoncrawl.org lookup address from each file's footer and sourceDate is the capture timestamp's date. (1) ASU Management 'Candidates on the Market' pages (2013-06-19 and 2013-12-06): job-market candidates only; the page says 'this year' without naming it, so listedYear is null with yearMeaning 'job-market'; fields of specialization and committee chairs are in note. No destinations. Contact details (phone, email) were deliberately not copied. (2) ASU Management Ph.D. Alumni (2013-12-10): 57 graduates; the page states the list gives current affiliation, graduation year and dissertation title, so listedYear = the year printed after the dissertation (yearMeaning 'graduation', month in note) and destination = the page's CURRENT affiliation as of 2013, not the first job (integrator: treat destination as current affiliation). Six rows have no affiliation. 'John Millikinbr' is kept as written (probably 'John Millikin' + stray
). This is an organizational behavior/strategy management program, not operations; included because the brief says to record every doctoral graduate listed. Kristie Rogers and Yiwen Zhang appear both as June-2013 job-market candidates and as May-2013 graduates on the alumni page. (3) BU Operations & Technology Management 'Placement of Doctoral Graduates' (2013-12-09): 22 graduates, 1985-2000. Each row is name, dissertation, a month-year like 'May-00', and 'Currently at , '. The date's meaning is not labelled (yearMeaning 'unstated'; it follows the dissertation title and is most plausibly the degree date; two-digit years expanded as 1985-2000). Destination/position are the page's CURRENT affiliation as of 2013, not the initial placement, despite the page title. Emad Fakhoury has no affiliation. Degree recorded as 'Doctoral' from the page title. Names kept in 'Last, First' order as written. (4) OSU Operations Management PhD alumni table (2019-02-22): 80 rows 1970-2016 with columns Alumni | Graduation Year | Initial Placement | First Tenure-Granting Institution | Current Institution. listedYear = Graduation Year ('graduation'); destination = Initial Placement (empty cells -> null, flagged in note); the First Tenure-Granting column is empty for every row; Current Institution kept in note. Page spellings such as 'Univeristy', 'Chrisopher Moyer', 'Illinios', 'Bera College' are preserved. Some initial placements are non-academic (Booz Allen Hamilton, Andersen Consulting). (5) OSU Fisher PhD Programs 'Alumni' page (2019-02-16): a featured-profiles page (14 people across finance, marketing, accounting, management and management sciences), not a complete list. Each heading gives the current institution and department; the PhD year comes from the bio prose ('graduation'). Henock Louis has no PhD year on the page (null). 'Johnathan Glover' heading vs 'Jonathan Glover' in the bio. Destination is the current institution as of 2019; position from the bio. Only Rachna Shah, Stephanie Eckerd and Gopesh Anand are Management Sciences (operations) graduates; Rachna Shah's bio states she has been at Minnesota since graduating (first job). No snapshot was unreadable. Integrator should double-check: the BU date meaning; that the ASU/BU 'destination' values are current affiliations rather than first jobs; and the OSU ops table cells where a cell wrapped over two lines (Vince Mabert/Purdue, Gopesh Anand, Toyin Clottey) which were joined when parsing.
